description: Add a QA note to an item. Append one typed QA note to a queue item. `kind` is `narrowing` (what now passes vs what still fails), `clarification` (what "fixed" now means), `verification` (requires a `verdict` of `pass` or `fail`, and `body` says what was checked) or `correction` (withdraws an earlier fr…

agent.description: The agent type writing the note — pass your own type when you are QA automation. Omitted, the note is attributed to the caller's identity.

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

kind.description: What a QA note is — `narrowing` (only part of the bug still fails), `clarification` (changes what "fixed" means), `verification` (a pass/fail verdict on a fix) or `correction` (withdraws an earlier framing).

listToken.description: REQUIRED. The `listToken` returned by the most recent `ops_qa_notes_list` call. It proves you listed existing ops qa notes and confirmed this one doesn't already exist before creating it. Call `ops_qa_notes_list` first if you don't have a fresh token.

name: ops_qa_notes_create
